result.description: Fires mainly on the ' PO' piece at the start of an acronym like "POV" (point of view) in writing/narrative text, where the next piece completes the acronym. It also fires weakly on other word-initial fragments.
result.label: ' PO' start of POV

result.description: Fires on the token " Fourier", mostly in math and signal-processing text such as "Fourier analysis" or "Fourier transforms". Members detect Fourier and related names (Taylor, Laplace, Joseph) and series/transform words. Weakly fires on "excell" in "excellence".
result.label: Fourier token detector

result.description: Fires on ' world' (also worlds) in fiction and worldbuilding text, as in "building a world", "worldview", "worldbuilders". It is weaker for generic "the world". It predicts compounds like "-wide" and "view".
result.label: ' world' in worldbuilding contexts
'icate' in 'delicate'
result.description: Fires on the piece 'icate' when it completes "delicate" (del|icate), strongest before foods like pastries. It stays silent on 'icate' in "intricate". Members mostly detect 'icate' itself.
Fires on the word piece "book"/"books", mostly at the end of "textbook(s)" (e.g. physics textbooks), and also on "ail" in "retailers". Members are book-piece detectors.
result.label: textbook / books word-piece

result.description: Fires on words meaning blending or combining things (blending via 'ending', ' combining', ' mixing'), especially after "involve", "principles of" or "by", where the next words name what is combined. Silent on 'ending' as in "transcending" or a plain ending.
result.label: Combining/blending gerund
"contact" after language (language contact)
result.description: Fires on the token ' contact' when it follows a modifier such as "language" or "eye", as in "language contact" in sociolinguistics text. It stays silent on ' contact' at the very start of a text, with no preceding word.
Fires on the ending of "carbon footprint(s)" (mostly 's' or 'print' after "foot") and on "emissions" in environmental text. Silent on other 's' tokens such as "impacts" or "it's".
result.label: carbon footprint / emissions ending

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'oid' in technical words like geoid and ellipsoid (geodesy/math context). Members are mostly 'oid' detectors from earlier layers; it stays silent on other tokens.
result.label: 'oid' suffix in geoid/ellipsoid
' contradict' word-stem detector
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' contradict' (contradictory, contradictions, contradicts), mostly in abstract or philosophical prose. A member from layer 4 that fires on the same token drives it, along with related words such as conflic-, oppos-, and question.

Fires on the 'ous' ending of 'meticulous' (also weakly on 'methodical'), when it modifies a following noun such as care, observation or analysis. It stays silent on 'ous' in other words like 'nebulous' and 'arousing'.
result.label: 'meticulous' word ending

result.description: Fires on ' reached' when it is a verb with an abstract subject attaining a level or state (e.g. "architecture reached its peak"). Silent on "reached for it", where it means stretching a hand out. Members detect reach/reaching forms.
result.label: ' reached' as attaining a level

result.description: Fires on the word " formal" as a modifier before a noun, often in history or math text (the formal formulation, formal proof), and pushes toward suffixes like -ization, -ism and -ized. It is silent when "formal" starts the document.
result.label: ' formal' predicting -ization/-ism

result.description: Fires on the start of a word piece (often ' bo' in boiling, ' ge', ' h') or a participle after "instead of", "not", or "typically/traditionally". It predicts a word continuation piece.
result.label: Word-start pieces after negation/instead of

result.description: Fires on the 'in' piece at the end of "grain" (gra|in), when the word is split into pieces. It stays silent on 'in' inside other split words like "strain" and "fascinating". Weaker on similar word-internal pieces such as 'ant' in "elephant".
result.label: 'in' inside split word "grain"

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a field or discipline name right after "in the field/realm/world of" (bi-, chem-, psych-, ac-, tissue, programming). It predicts academic field words like sciences, engineering, medicine.
result.label: Field name after "realm of"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ic' completing "electromagnetic" (occasionally 'ien' in "Experiencing" nearby). Silent on 'ic' in other words like isentropic, atmospheric, proficiency. Members detect 'electromagnet' and related physics context.
result.label: 'ic' ending of electromagnetic

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments (zy, inet, ichi, emat) inside technical science terms like kinetics, kinematics, stoichiometric, mostly in chemistry/physics text. Weaker on Arrhenius and gluten. Silent on the whole word 'mechanics'.
result.label: Mid-word pieces of chemistry/physics terms

result.description: Fires mainly on dash tokens (' --', em dash) used as parenthetical or appositive breaks in running prose, and secondarily on ' organization'. Dash members dominate the circuit; it is silent on text without such dashes.
result.label: Dash punctuation (' --') and 'organization'

result.description: Fires on ' to' (occasionally ' for') right after "in order", the purpose-clause opener, especially at the start of a document. Silent on other infinitive ' to' after nouns or verbs. Predicts adverbs like "effectively" or "properly".
result.label: "to" after "in order"

result.description: Fires on the word right after a form of "draw" (draws the viewer, draws attention, draw on), mostly ' the'. It stays silent on ' the' after other verbs or prepositions. Predicts attention/conclusion-like objects.
result.label: Word after "draw(s)" (draws the viewer)

result.description: Fires on ' also' used as an additive adverb after a subject noun, clause boundary or comma (e.g. "period also", "; also", ", also known as"). Silent on ' also' after an auxiliary verb ("had also been") or at text start.
result.label: Additive ' also' after subject/clause

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " ret" when it begins a longer word, most strongly in "online retailers/retailing/retail". Members are mostly " ret" detectors (retention, retina), and the target predicts continuations like "ail".
result.label: " ret" word-start fragment (retail)

result.description: Fires on the letter token 'Q' (or ' Q') used as a symbol, such as an orthogonal matrix Q or the Q in QED. It predicts that more capital letters follow. Members are mostly Q-token detectors.
result.label: Letter Q symbol/acronym token

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' expl' when it begins a word like exploration, explores or explorers, and predicts the continuation (oration, ores, oring). Silent when ' expl' starts the text or appears as a sentence-initial ' exploring'.
result.label: ' expl' word-start (explore/exploration)

result.description: Fires on the 's' (or 'S') that ends a decade plural like 1970s, 80s or 90's, usually after a year number. It stays silent on possessive 's after names and nouns.
result.label: Decade suffix 's' (1970s)

result.description: Fires on the word "electron" (and "electrons", "Electron") in physics and chemistry text about atomic structure, such as configurations, shells and transfer. Members are mostly electron-token detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: electron token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' home' (also in word starts like home-omorphic, homeostasis, homeopathy), in phrases such as "at home" and "from home". Members are mostly ' home' detectors across layers.
result.label: ' home' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'hip' completing words like craftsmanship, sportsmanship, artisanship. It depends on the preceding word stem (craftsmans-), and it is weakly active on 'asure' in treasure.
result.label: 'hip' suffix in craftsmanship

result.description: Fires on the word " above" in its spatial or positional sense (high above, lies above, bounded above, orbiting above). Members include detectors of above/below/beyond and related position words. Silent on text without the word.
result.label: ' above' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " domestic" (as in domestic industry, production, currency), mostly in economics and trade text after a verb like protect or boost. Members detect domestic/local/national-type adjectives.
result.label: ' domestic' in trade economics

result.description: Fires on ' DNA' (also 'le' in "nucleic" and ' gene') in molecular biology text, such as DNA replication, templates, and nucleic acids. It is quiet on cDNA in an unrelated cloning context.
result.label: DNA in molecular biology

result.description: Fires on the ending piece of folklore/legend words ('ore' in folklore, 'ends' in legends, ' tales'), in text about myths, folk traditions and stories. Predicts next tokens like trad(itions), tales, stories, songs.
result.label: Folklore and legends word endings

result.description: Fires on abstract nouns like "environment", "atmosphere", "culture" (also "ambiance") right after "create/foster a/an", as in "create an environment of trust/conducive to". Predicts continuations like "conducive" or "of trust".
result.label: Created environment/atmosphere/culture noun
' black' token detector
result.description: Fires on the word ' black', mostly in physics text before 'hole' (black holes), and also in red-black tree node text. Members are mostly ' black' detectors plus 'hole' and 'dark' related latents. Predicts ' hole'.

Fires on the verb ending 'als' in 'reveals' (also 'poses' in 'exposes') when an abstract subject, such as a study or analysis, is said to reveal or expose something. Silent on 'als' in nouns like 'universals' or in 'falsifiability'.
result.label: reveals/exposes verb ending

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' Reg' (also ' reg') when it begins a longer word split into pieces, such as Regression or Reggae/Reggaeton. Members are detectors of Reg/reg and similar word-initial fragments.
result.label: ' Reg' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ing" completing "wield" (wielding), and weakly on similar pieces like "unyielding". It predicts objects of wielding such as influence, tools, weights. It stays silent on "ing" in other verbs.
result.label: -ing suffix of "wielding"

result.description: Fires on frequency adverbs ' typically' and ' usually' after a plural or generic subject in explanatory statements (e.g. "phrases usually begin with"), where a general rule or pattern is being described. Weakly on ' primarily'.
result.label: typically/usually generic-statement adverbs

result.description: Fires on ' cross' (and sometimes ' run') as a word-initial prefix piece before a hyphen or continuation, as in cross-border, cross-cultural, cross-validation, surface run|off. Predicts compound continuations.
result.label: cross-/run- compound prefix

result.description: Fires on 'ate' completing the word "innate" (inn|ate), in discussions of innate abilities, immunity or structures. Predicts nouns like effects, dependency, relations. Members detect 'ate' and related pieces like intrinsic.
result.label: 'ate' in "innate"

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces ' orbit', ' reg' (regul-) and 'g' in 'congestion', mostly in repeated or scientific text. Members detect orbit, regul and con-fragments; the target seems to predict word continuations like -ulation, -olds.
result.label: orbit / reg / con-g word fragments

result.description: Fires on ' of' directly after "one" in the "one of the most/key..." construction (also "One of" at sentence start). Silent on ' of' after other nouns like "aspect of" or "part of".
result.label: ' of' after "one"

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' strateg' (before "ies") and ' phys' (before "iology"), mostly after a modifier noun such as "pricing" or "Endocrine". It predicts the suffix continuation; it is silent on some ' strateg' contexts.
result.label: strateg-/phys- word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on a plural category noun (factors, aspects, areas, fields, methods, species) right after "other" in phrases like "among other factors" or "or other methods". It stays silent after "these" or "external".
result.label: Noun after "other" in lists

result.description: Fires on ' like' right after a perception or linking verb (seem, sound, feel, look) where it introduces an impression or comparison ("may sound like an overkill"). Silent on ' like' as a preposition after a noun, colon, or "much like".
result.label: 'like' after seem/sound/feel/look

result.description: Fires on the adjective " simple" (occasionally "straightforward" or "rud-"), mostly describing basic or early versions of technology, tools or systems. Members detect simple/basic/primitive words. Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: Adjective "simple" (basic/primitive)

result.description: Fires on the word " diagonal", mostly in linear algebra text about diagonal matrices. Members include math and matrix context detectors (linear, eigenvectors, multiplication) and a diagonal token detector. Silent on other matrix text like "inverse matrix".
result.label: " diagonal" in matrix text

result.description: Fires on ' early' used as an adjective meaning 'earliest/ancient' before a plural noun (early predecessors, early cave paintings). It stays silent on ' early' in date phrases like 'early 19th' or 'the early part of'.
result.label: ' early' as 'ancient/primitive' adjective

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Id"/" id" that begins "idiom(s)" or "idiomatic", as in "Idioms in Business" headings and "linguistic idioms". Members are detectors of this piece, and it predicts continuations like "ios"/"iom".
result.label: ' Id' piece starting 'idiom'

result.description: Fires on the word " quantum" (and the start of "Quantum") across physics and computing text. Members are mostly detectors of "quantum" or "Quant|um". It predicts continuations like computing, bits, gate and advantage.
result.label: quantum token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " research" (occasionally " study") as a noun in scientific or methodology text, such as "biological research" or "research findings". Next-token logits favour words like "integrity" and "Valid". Members are mostly detectors of "research" and related science words.
result.label: " research" in scientific methodology text
'b' in 'turbines'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'b' inside split words, mainly 'tur|b|ines' in energy and power-generation text. Also seen in 'micro|b|acterium' and 'he|b|domar'. Members are 'b' detectors.

Fires on scattered tokens that precede a suffix-like continuation: ' container' before "ization", 'e' in "in-e-fficiency", ' ###' heading at document start, ' Princi'. Logits favor word-piece continuations such as 'ffic'. Mixed evidence.
result.label: Mixed tokens predicting word-piece continuations

result.description: Fires on the prefix " micro" / " Micro" / " macro" (as in microstate, microscopic, microblogging), where a word continuation like -scope, -state or -phone is expected. Members are mostly detectors of this prefix.
result.label: micro/macro prefix token

result.description: Fires on ' by' introducing the agent after a passive past participle (created by, formed by, laid by, provided by). Silent on ' by' after other verbs/nouns or in non-agent uses (plagued by, abide by, reducing X by).
result.label: Passive agent ' by'

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in the middle of a longer word, mainly 'oph' in "Diophantine" and ' Des' in "Descartes". It needs the preceding piece (Di, René) and predicts the word's continuation. It is silent on the complete word "Cogito".
result.label: Mid-word fragments: Di-oph, Des-cartes

result.description: Fires on the pronoun " it" (also "they") as the subject of a clause, strongest after comparative "as" ("as challenging as it sounds") or a conjunction. It is quiet when "it" is an object, as in "make it seem" or "spot it".
result.label: Subject 'it' after 'as'/conjunction

result.description: Fires on the word "Interface"/"interface", mostly in "User Interface" within UI/UX design text. Members detect interface, user experience and related design words before it.
result.label: "Interface" in user interface

result.description: Fires on the ending piece "ics" (or "ytics") in "analytics", especially in data/business analytics contexts. It stays silent on "ics" in other words such as economics, robotics or photonics.
result.label: "ics" ending of "analytics"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "istic" completing the word "heuristic" (Heur-istic), mostly before "algorithms". It stays silent on "istic" in words like "probabilistic" and "sophisticated".
result.label: "istic" in "heuristic"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' lingu' (also 'ingu') when it begins "linguistic(s)" or similar words, typically after a modifier like cognitive or computational. It predicts continuations like 'istic'/'istics'. Silent on one "compares lingu-istic" example.
result.label: lingu- word piece (linguistics)

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' V' (VR, VPN, VLAN, Vision) and on 'oe' inside onomatopoeia or thermoelectric, where the token is an early fragment of a longer word or acronym. Weak on other mid-word pieces.
result.label: ' V' and 'oe' word fragments

result.description: Fires on a standalone space token that precedes a year number's digits, especially after "from around", "from about", "between" in date-range phrases for historical periods. Silent on spaces after "the" or "late" before century or decade numbers.
result.label: Space before year in date range

result.description: Fires on the 'ive' suffix completing "intuitive", in UI/design text where interfaces or navigation come next. Stays silent on 'ive' in collective, immersive, reflective and adaptive.
result.label: 'ive' in "intuitive"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "atial" completing "geospatial" (also weakly "icult"). Members detect geo-/spatial word fragments such as "oge", "od", "spatial", "territorial" and "ometric", which together build up the word.
result.label: "atial" in geospatial

result.description: Fires on the ending piece of a word meaning revival or renewal ("rev|ival", "rediscover|y", "renew|al") in text about the Renaissance and cultural rebirth. It stays silent on the verb "revived" in a similar context.
result.label: Revival word endings in Renaissance text
Verb-start piece after 'approach'
result.description: Fires on the beginning piece of a transitive verb (en-compasses, prior-itizes, prom-otes, align-s) right after the noun 'approach' or 'method', as the subject's verb. It stays silent on 'en' in other slots, such as after 'and'.
Fires on the word-piece ending "ous" in "autonomous" (also "gent", "line", "ized"), predicting nouns like operations, decision, navigation. Mostly in autonomous-systems and robotics text.
result.label: autonom-ous word-piece before system nouns

result.description: Fires on the piece 'loy' inside "alloy" (alloying, alloyed), mostly in metallurgy and materials text. It fires weakly on ' adv' in "advances/advancements". Members are mostly 'loy' and 'ys' piece detectors.
result.label: 'loy' in alloy

result.description: Fires on the letter "P" used as a propositional or probability variable (P implies Q, if P, P(A|B)). Weakly fires on P- word starts like Pythagoras. Supported by logic and statement members.
result.label: P as logic variable

result.description: Fires on nouns naming a category of art or historical time, mainly " genre" and " Age" (Digital Age, Stone Age), also " era" and " landscape". Seems to be a modifier-plus-noun slot, used in art and history writing.
result.label: genre / Age / era category nouns

result.description: Fires on the word " such" used as a determiner right after a verb or preposition, as in "govern such", "predict such", "in such", before a noun. Weak or silent when " such" follows a comma and leads into "such as".
result.label: " such" as determiner after verb/preposition

result.description: Fires on the token " charged", mostly in physics and chemistry text about electrically charged particles (e.g. "negatively charged", "between charged particles"). It predicts particle-related next words. Members detect charge, ion and subatomic words.
result.label: ' charged' in particle physics
'ap' piece after S (Sapir)
result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ap' right after an initial 'S', mainly in "Sapir" (Sapir-Whorf). It fires more weakly on similar mid-word pieces such as 'oph' in "sophisticated" and 'yl' in "syllogisms".
Fires on the "ils" piece in split-up "soils" (so|ils), and more weakly on " soil", in soil science text about texture, porosity and engineering. Members detect "il" after "So" and soil-related words.
result.label: "ils" in "soils"

result.description: Fires on the end of words naming inner conflict or hardship (turmoil, struggles, dilemmas, conflict) in writing about story characters and narrative craft. Members are mostly fiction/character-topic detectors.
result.label: Internal struggle words in fiction

result.description: Fires on the ' re' piece that begins "reactions" right after a chemistry word like "redox", "chemical" or "electrolysis". It stays silent when ' re' starts a sentence or begins other words like "reagents".
result.label: ' re' of redox reactions

result.description: Fires on the verb " are" (and "aren" in "aren't"), most strongly after plural subjects like "areas", in descriptive or definitional statements. It stays silent on some "are" tokens, for example in relative clauses or after certain subjects, and the evidence doesn't say why.
result.label: Plural-subject verb " are"

result.description: Fires on the final piece "us" completing the word "nucleus" (atomic nucleus, in physics text). It stays silent on "us" in other words, such as "usually".
result.label: "us" ending "nucleus"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'era' inside "therapeutic" (th|era|peutic), predicting the following 'pe'. Members are detectors of 'era' and similar mid-word pieces after 'th'. Only weakly fires on 'era' in "ephemera".
result.label: 'era' in "therapeutic"

result.description: Fires on the digit '5' as the third digit of a number starting with "1" (e.g. 15xx years, 150). Silent on '5' in other positions, such as after 9 or 17, or at the start of a number.
result.label: Digit 5 after leading 1

result.description: Fires on the word piece " cre" at the start of a word such as creep or creative/creativity, mostly in materials-science "creep" passages. It predicts continuations like "ep", "ative" and "ativity".
result.label: ' cre' word-start piece (creep/creative)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mult' (start of multi-), strongest after "a/are" in phrases like "a multidimensional/multifaceted". Silent on 'multicultural' in the contrast, so it seems to need the multidimensional/multifaceted-type continuation context. Predicts 'if', 'itude', 'ities'.
result.label: ' mult' prefix before multifaceted

result.description: Fires on the word "resource"/"resources" (singular and plural) in allocation, management and utilization contexts. Members are mostly earlier-layer detectors of the same token. It predicts allocation-related continuations.
result.label: resource(s) in allocation contexts

result.description: Fires on the token ' defined', most strongly in "is/are defined as" definitional phrasing. Weaker in "richly defined" or "defined success as". Predicts 'as' or 'differently' next. Members are mostly detectors of defined/described/characterized.
result.label: ' defined' in "is defined as"

result.description: Fires on the word piece completing a social-structure term right after "social" or in hierarchy words (social strat-ification, hierarch-ies, social class, hierarchy). Predicts continuations like "strat", "arch", "class".
result.label: Social hierarchy/stratification terms

result.description: Fires on the word piece "antic" in "Rom-antic" (Romanticism, Romantic), the movement or era. It stays silent when "antic" appears alone at the start of a text, so it needs the preceding "Rom" piece.
result.label: "antic" in Romantic/Romanticism

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' int' when it begins a longer word, mostly "intimacy/intimate" and also "intake". It predicts continuations like 'imate' and 'ently'. It stays silent when ' int' is the first token of the document.
result.label: ' int' word-start piece (intimacy)

result.description: Fires on mixed word pieces and tokens, mainly ' significant', 'arr' (in Narrative), and 'ider' (in Collider), plus a few others. Peaks look unrelated, with low consistency, so there is no clear shared meaning.
result.label: Mixed tokens: significant, arr, ider

result.description: Fires on the word pieces 'iller', 'illing' and 'ill' after 'thr' in "thriller/thrilling/thrillers", in writing and genre text. Weak activation on similar pieces like 'exc-iting'.
result.label: thr-iller / thr-illing word piece

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a language or language-family name (Finn-, Mand-, Mal-, Sah-, Kho-, Russ-) inside linguistics text about language families, where the name continues in the next token.
result.label: Language name first fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' narr' (start of narrator, narrative, narration), mostly when it follows a modifier such as Unreliable, Multiple, or Non-linear. Silent when it opens a text with no preceding context.
result.label: ' narr' word-start piece
' ret' word-start piece
result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' ret' (retention, retail, retina) when it is split from the rest of the word, predicting a continuation like 'ention'. Weakly also on similar fragments such as ' sust'.
Fires on the word "unit"/"units" (and Unit) as a noun, such as processing units, units of measurement, unit cell or unit tests. Members are mostly detectors of unit/units tokens.
result.label: unit / units token detector
